title: Sweet Date Skewers
description: A simple and delicious dessert made with sweet dates and lovely skewers.
instructions: Soak the wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Thread a date onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each date.
Drizzle the egyptian honey over the dates.
Sprinkle chopped pistachios, sliced almonds, and coconut flakes over the dates.
Season with a pinch of salt.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until caramelized.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
